purpose: Predeclared rules for a DESCRIPTIVE leveraged-ETF trend backtest on Alpaca-only data. Canonical configs are fixed in advance; nothing is tuned or selected; the verdict can be INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL, never a pass. Edited only by adding a new version file; the CLI refuses to run if lev-backtest-prereg.v2.sha256 does not match this file.

supersedes.file: lev-backtest-prereg.json (archived byte-for-byte as lev-backtest-prereg.v1-archived.json; its hash stays in lev-backtest-prereg.sha256)
supersedes.note: v1 failed because Alpaca IEX history starts 2020-07-27, not ~2016: its tune window (through 2021-12-31) would have been ~17 months and could not carry a selection. No other data source is available to the owner. v1 is kept for its tune/test machinery but is NOT used. v2 replaces the frozen tune/test design with a descriptive design that has no tuning and no selection, so it cannot establish a durable edge.

data.source: Alpaca IEX daily bars, adjustment=all (split+dividend adjusted), via fleet paper keys, read from the local cache bus/fleet/data/lev-bars/ (no network at backtest time)
data.excludedWhy: SQQQ/UVXY reverse splits and short exposure; SOXL sector-specific (limits multiplicity); SGOV only trades from 2020 so the cash leg is BIL for the whole period
data.knownCacheIssues: SPY has one stray bar dated 2018-11-01 (before every other series); BIL lacks 14 dates that the other series have. The CLI drops every bar dated before startDate (2020-07-27) BEFORE any computation and reports what it dropped; the engine then aligns each pair on the INTERSECTION of underlying, traded and BIL dates and the CLI reports the dates lost to alignment.
data.sanity: flag a day when |ret_etf - L * ret_underlying| exceeds 0.10, or |log return| exceeds 0.70 (checked after the pre-startDate drop); a flag stops the run for manual review. There is NO fixed 0.35 cap (TQQQ fell ~35% on 2020-03-16, which is before the sample anyway).

cashLeg: BIL (adjusted total return) while out of market
execution: signal on the underlying's close at t; fill at the traded ETF's open at t+1 (bars[i+1].open); no fill at the same bar as the signal
warmup: no signal until the longest SMA window has a full set of closes; the first 250 aligned bars only fill the window (common warm-up for every config, so every config is scored over the identical span)

S1_trend_band.rule: long when underlying close > SMA(n)*(1+band); flat when close < SMA(n)*(1-band); otherwise keep the prior state

S2_dual_fast_exit.rule: long when SMA(50) > SMA(slow) and close > SMA(slow); exit when underlying close < SMA(50) OR the underlying's close falls trailingDD below its high since entry; re-enter only when the entry condition is true again

S3_vol_target.rule: S1(n=200, band=2) gate; when long, weight = min(1, targetVol / (leverage * realizedVol20(underlying))); rest in cash leg
S3_vol_target.note: secondary; weak fit for a $50 account

strategies.canonicalWhy: S1 (200-day SMA, 2% band) and S2 (200-day slow, 10% trailing stop) are conventional textbook values; S3 target vol 20% is the middle of a plain 15/20 choice. They were fixed BEFORE any run on this cache and are never changed after seeing results.

evaluation.canonicalPairs: each of the 6 pairs (QQQ->TQQQ, QQQ->QLD, QQQ->QQQ, SPY->UPRO, SPY->SSO, SPY->SPY) x S1, S2, S3, plus buy-and-hold of the traded ETF and of the underlying

spans.full: every aligned date after the common 250-bar warm-up (the equity curve starts at the close of bar 250; the first possible fill is the open of bar 251)

y2022.note: the one bear market in the sample, reported separately

spans.firstHalf: first half of the full span, split by number of daily returns (midpoint = base + 1 + floor(days/2); this date is the first day of the second half)
spans.secondHalf: second half of the full span

evaluation.signalState: signals are causal and computed on all earlier history, so a sub-span starts with whatever position state the rule already had; the sub-span equity curve starts at the close before its first day
evaluation.sensitivity: The same grids as v1 are evaluated on the FULL span at 5 bps, idealized fractional, for DESCRIPTIVE sensitivity only. It is a table. Nothing is chosen from it, no config is promoted, and it feeds no verdict.

costs.expenseRatio: NOT added: adjusted prices already net the fund's expense ratio out of NAV (adding it would double-count)
costs.cash: BIL adjusted returns already include its yield

cashAccountRules: engine forbids a round trip that opens and closes on the same day (no selling a position bought with unsettled funds). A same-open swap between traded ETF and BIL is allowed. Whether Alpaca applies further rules is UNVERIFIED.
variants: whole-share with the $20 position cap (report the traded ETF's price against the cap; if one share exceeds $20 the variant can never buy and is reported as such)

verdictRule.noPass: Only INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL exist in this mode. A pass verdict is impossible by construction: the sample is ~6 years with one bear market and no independent validation window.
verdictRule.evaluatedOn: the FULL span, canonical configs, the two primary hypotheses only (S1 on QQQ->TQQQ and S2 on QQQ->TQQQ), idealized fractional, 5 bps/side
criteriaPerHypothesis: max drawdown smaller than buy-and-hold of the traded ETF (TQQQ) AND Calmar higher than that buy-and-hold
after-cost CAGR (5 bps/side) higher than buy-and-hold of the underlying (QQQ)
verdictRule.FAIL: if either primary hypothesis fails either criterion
verdictRule.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise (both hypotheses meet both criteria; this still establishes nothing durable)
reportedNotGating: every secondary pair, span and variant
round-trip counts per config (too few for confidence intervals to mean anything, stated in the report)
decomposition: strategy vs traded-ETF buy-and-hold (drawdown avoidance vs timing)
verdictRule.confidenceIntervals: not computed: with a handful of round trips a confidence interval would mean nothing

multipleTesting.deflatedSharpe: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014): DSR = Phi( (SR_hat - SR0) * sqrt(T-1) / sqrt(1 - g3*SR_hat + ((g4-1)/4)*SR_hat^2) ), SR0 = sqrt(V[SR]) * ((1-gamma)*Phi^-1(1-1/N) + gamma*Phi^-1(1-1/(N*e))), gamma = 0.5772
multipleTesting.N: count of every config in the descriptive sensitivity grid, treated as uncorrelated (conservative): (20 + 9 + 2) configs x 6 pairs = 186
multipleTesting.stepSizes: n in steps of 25; band in steps of 1 percentage point; slow in {150,200,250}; trailingDD in {8,10,15}

disclosures: Stress period 2008-2009 is absent from Alpaca IEX history; maximum-drawdown figures are NOT the historical worst case for these instruments.
IEX bars are one exchange's prints; the 'open' is IEX's first trade, not the official opening auction.
Round-trip counts in the evaluation span will be small; confidence intervals are illustrative only.
Sample is 2020-07-27 to 2026-09-25 (~6 years) with essentially one bear market; the tune window is not used; nothing here can establish a durable edge.
unverified: Alpaca free-tier history start date (recorded at first fetch: 2020-07-27)
cash-account good-faith/settlement handling beyond the same-day rule

forwardLog.gateC: >=60 trading days AND >=1 completed entry->exit round trip in the forward log, or an explicit owner waiver with a documented reason
forwardLog.mustNotImport: any order-submission path (survive-executor.js, alpaca submitOrder); selftest asserts no order calls

secrets: error messages must redact APCA-API-KEY-ID and APCA-API-SECRET-KEY values; selftest asserts no key substring in any thrown error
